findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vela.corpus.query, vela.library.reading_list, vela.magazine.sequence_path · Private data: vela.magazine.sequence_path, vela.research.list_studies · Public sink: vela.corpus.query, vela.magazine.sequence_path · Destructive: vela.magazine.relation_floor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vela.corpus.query, vela.library.reading_list, vela.magazine.sequence_path · Private data: vela.magazine.sequence_path, vela.research.list_studies · Public sink: vela.corpus.query, vela.magazine.sequence_path · Destructive: vela.magazine.relation_floor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
